Prompts

```
['create a MultiAgentDialogOnboardWorld to onboard a single agent with welcome messages', 'run a MultiAgentDialogWorld parley loop for round-robin multi-agent dialogue with max turns', 'shutdown all MTurk agents in parallel using joblib threading to avoid blocking', 'use make_world to instantiate a MultiAgentDialogWorld with opt config and agent list', 'call get_world_params to retrieve the default agent count configuration for the world']
```

Usage

```
{'create_onboarding_world': 'create a MultiAgentDialogOnboardWorld to onboard a single agent with welcome messages', 'run_multiagent_dialog': 'run a MultiAgentDialogWorld parley loop for round-robin multi-agent dialogue with max turns', 'shutdown_agents_parallel': 'shutdown all MTurk agents in parallel using joblib threading to avoid blocking', 'make_world_factory': 'use make_world to instantiate a MultiAgentDialogWorld with opt config and agent list', 'get_world_params': 'call get_world_params to retrieve the default agent count configuration for the world'}
```
